summary: Iteration 8 - full validation of property management fixes, 3-status tenants (paid/not_paid/late), registration uploads, ZIP bundle, OCR original file save, room edit, and dashboard filtered links. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests PASS (auth/me, dashboard stats contains tenants_late/tenants_paid/tenants_not_paid as ints, GET /api/tenants returns payment_status in {paid,not_paid,late}, POST /api/tenants succeeds without 'address' and without 'phone' (only required fields), status=late/paid/not_paid filters work and return only matching tenants with month_paid_amount + month_payment_method, POST /api/properties without property_code returns auto-generated code matching IMM-XXXX (8 chars) with no deposit_amount in payload, POST /api/registration/upload + /api/contracts/upload + /api/owner-documents/upload all persist documents and return /uploads/documents/... urls, GET /api/documents/bundle/{tenant_id} returns real application/zip bytes with at least one entry, POST /api/ocr/scan returns saved_file_url pointing to /uploads/documents/). Frontend (Playwright, logged in via reCAPTCHA test token): sidebar has exactly 13 items in correct order including 'Registrazione'; Dashboard renders 'Inquilini In Ritardo' link to /tenants?status=late (plus paid & not_paid); /tenants?status=late loads with 4 filter tabs (Tutti 8 / Pagato 1 / Non Pagato 0 / In Ritardo 2) - data-testid=filter-{all|paid|not_paid|late} all present; tenants table headers are exactly ['Nome','Immobile','Stanza','Deposito','Stato Mese','Azioni'] - NO address column; tenant name link points to /tenants/{uuid}; Nuovo Immobile dialog contains no 'Deposito' field and no 'property_code' input (auto-generated); /registration page loads with 1 file input and shows ZIP/Pacchetto + Carica/upload copy; /rooms page shows 'Modifica' UI text and edit pencil icons on every room row (both occupied and vacant). No console errors captured.

issues: Edit pencil buttons are visible on every room row but have NO data-testid (e.g. data-testid=edit-room-{id}). Functionally works but makes future automated testing brittle.

Tenants.js useEffect has empty dep array [] while reading searchParams.get('status'). First mount reads correctly (confirmed), but navigating between /tenants?status=paid and /tenants?status=late without a full remount will not update the tab - add searchParams to dep array for correctness.
'Ospitalita' and 'Nazionalita' still missing Italian accent (cosmetic, carried from iter-7).

action_items: (Low) Add data-testid='edit-room-{id}' to the room edit buttons in Rooms.js for testability.
(Low) Fix Tenants.js useEffect dependency array to include searchParams so filter tab updates on in-app URL changes.
(Optional cosmetic) Fix Italian accents: 'Ospitalità', 'Nazionalità', 'attività' across Layout + pages.

(Optional) Tenants table still shows 'Deposito' column - request only said remove address, but confirm with user whether deposit column should also be hidden now that PropertyCreate has no deposit_amount.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/tenants.py _enrich_tenant: when due_day check puts a tenant in 'late', it also requires room_id. A tenant WITHOUT a room will always show 'not_paid' even past due day - intentional but worth a comment.

routes/properties.py generate_property_code retries only 10 times for uniqueness; with 26^4=458k combos collisions are extremely unlikely but loop exits silently on failure leaving property_code='' - consider raising 500 or falling back to UUID slice.
routes/registration.py duplicates upload logic 3x (registration/contract/owner-documents) with only filename prefix + owner_type differing - extract a _save_doc(...) helper to honour DRY.
routes/dashboard.py still computes total_deposits from tenants.deposit_amount which lingers from legacy schema; if deposit_amount is dropped from tenants later this will silently return 0.
Tenants.js resetForm + formData still carries deposit_amount=0 which is fine, but id_type/id_number are in state yet never rendered as inputs - dead fields.
seed_data_creation: Test run uploaded 3 small 1x1 PNG documents (registration, contract, owner) against the first seeded tenant/landlord and 1 OCR image under /app/backend/uploads/documents. All have predictable prefixes (reg_, contract_, owner_, ocr_). Safe to leave; main agent can purge with: rm /app/backend/uploads/documents/reg_* /app/backend/uploads/documents/contract_* /app/backend/uploads/documents/owner_* /app/backend/uploads/documents/ocr_* and db.documents.delete_many({filename: {$in: ['test_reg.png','test_contract.png','test_owner.png','ocrsmall.png','bundle_seed.png']}}).

DB state: 2 properties, 3 rooms, 8 tenants (1 paid, 2 late, 0 explicit not_paid since day<=5 edge), 3 payments, several documents. All 23 feature bullets in the review request verified green end-to-end. Next agent should add edit-room-{id} data-testid before testing room-edit flow from the UI, and should confirm the useSearchParams fix if main agent applies it (reproduce by clicking dashboard 'Pagato' link while already on /tenants?status=late - current code keeps the old tab highlighted until page refresh).
rca_of_the_issue: No bug RCA required - all 23 features requested in features_or_bugs_to_test work correctly. Only 2 low-priority polish items surfaced: (1) missing data-testid on room edit buttons (Rooms.js), (2) Tenants.js useEffect dep-array missing searchParams so in-app URL changes don't re-run the filter initializer. Neither blocks the feature. Backend 13/13, frontend 100%.
